The Gene2Vec implementation is unspecified; the paper does not establish whether it is a lookup table, learned projection, or another embedding module.
The pathway database identity, gene-membership relation, matching rule, and pooling statistic are unspecified.
The exact masking values, mask representation, prediction heads, and target receipt for all modality-specific MLM branches are unspecified.
The exact query/key/value assignment and internal schedule of multimodal task-head cross-attention are unspecified.
The report-generation decoder, target-token serialization, teacher-forcing inputs, and decoding procedure are unspecified.
The exact task-head architecture is unspecified beyond cross-attention for multimodal tasks and MLPs for other tasks.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Region-wise arithmetic-mean aggregation of WSI feature regions
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The source explicitly replaces every spatial region with its arithmetic mean. The pinned catalog has partition and projection primitives but no arithmetic aggregation operation, so the step remains an opaque boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Pathway matching, grouping, and pooling of gene features
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents matching genes to biological pathway databases, grouping genes into pathways, and pooling each pathway. No catalog operation represents this correspondence-based grouping and pooling computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Optical character recognition from PDF diagnostic reports
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents symbolic tokenization and textual serialization, but no operation converts PDF content into extracted report text through OCR.
The paper states that Gene2Vec provides gene-name embeddings but does not establish a lookup-table resource, projection formula, or parameter state. The module remains opaque.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Downstream task-specific re-embedding of CLS tokens
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Cross-attention exists, but the paper does not establish the query/key/value assignment, sequence order, or exact re-embedding schedule.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Inter-modal CLIP contrastive loss between modality CLS representations
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains representation transformations but no loss operation for pairwise CLIP contrastive learning.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Inter-sample cancer-category triplet-loss computation from sample-level CLS representations
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains concatenation and correspondence primitives but no metric-learning triplet-loss operation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Modality-specific masked-language-model objective with random modality selection every 10 epochs
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent some masking inputs and branch selection but has no operation for the documented MLM prediction/loss computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Task-specific survival, classification, and report-generation loss computations
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains representation transformations but no task-loss operations for Cox survival loss, cross-entropy, or autoregressive report-generation loss.
